answer: Harbor delta-ladder: each identity docks at the harbor registry and takes the next rung of one global ladder, paying 20+8(k-1) credits burned. Each filer locks a 30-credit pearl bond, returned after one verified task; a rented rung burns the lender's pearl. A glacier ledger thaws 50 rungs per quiet epoch, so fresh wallets never reset it. 1,000 fakes cost 4,016,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 20 once and reclaims its pearl.
